discovery.title: Eagles preying on human-sized baboons upend existing evolutionary defense theory
discovery.summary: Researchers from the University of St Andrews have discovered that baboons the size of hominins (early human ancestors) are being preyed upon by eagles, reshaping the way scientists might think about predator–prey interactions during human evolution.
